interface.longDescription:
Storyflow is a visual workspace for planning creative work. This app connects ChatGPT to your Storyflow projects.

Ask about any project, like "What changed on the launch board this week, and who changed it?", and ChatGPT reads your boards and documents to answer. You can also ask it to build things for you. It can turn a brief into a project board, a plan, a document or a slide deck, and everything it makes appears in Storyflow, ready for your team to edit.

You sign in with your Storyflow account and choose which projects ChatGPT can use. It can't see or change any other project. Read access is always on, and you decide whether it can also make changes.
capabilities: Read your projects, boards and documents
Summarise what changed on a board and who changed it
Turn a brief into a project board, a plan, a document or a slide deck
defaultPrompt: What changed on my launch board this week, and who changed it?
Summarise my most active Storyflow board.
Turn this brief into a project board in Storyflow.

positive.prompt: Which projects do I have in Storyflow?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_projects and lists the project names the connection was granted, with no ids or internal fields.

positive.description: Reports a board's recent changes and who made them
positive.prompt: What changed on my launch board this week, and who changed it?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the board by name, reads its changes for the last seven days and answers with what changed grouped by collaborator name.

positive.prompt: Give me a summary of my launch board.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short summary of the board's sections, notes, todos and documents in plain language.

positive.description: Finds and reads a document by title
positive.prompt: Find my brand voice document in Storyflow and tell me what it says.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches by title, fetches the matching document and summarises its content.

positive.description: Builds a board from a brief. The test connection must be granted all projects, documents outside projects and write access: create_project and show_board are only offered on that grant.
positive.prompt: Turn this brief into a project board in Storyflow: a three-week launch for a podcast, with research, recording and promotion phases.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a project, shows the board, builds one section per phase with notes and todos, and links to the board. With read-only access it explains that write access was not granted.

negative.description: General knowledge question, no Storyflow data involved
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Creative writing with no project context
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.
Open my Notion workspace and list my pages.
